name: adstudio
description: Advertising reporting and analysis for the Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads accounts you connect in Adstudio, with the source behind every number.

interface.longDescription:
Adstudio is advertising reporting and analysis inside ChatGPT. Ask for the numbers from the Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads accounts you connect in Adstudio — spend, conversions, campaign structure and creatives — instead of opening each ads manager and rebuilding the same export.

Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers and growth teams who compare channels and investigate changes without opening each ads manager.

What you can ask
- "How did my Google Ads campaigns perform last week compared with the week before?"
- "Why did the CPA of my Brand Search campaign go up in the last 14 days?"
- "Which Meta campaigns spent budget without converting this month?"
- "Rank the ads in my Summer Sale campaign by ROAS and show me what the top three say."
- "Break down my TikTok Ads spend by placement for the last 30 days."

What ChatGPT can read through this plugin
Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads.
Data: campaigns, ad groups, ad sets, ads and creatives, plus spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, conversion value, impression share, reach, frequency and video metrics, with period comparisons and breakdowns by date, device, placement, age or gender.

Every answer states the account, currency, date range, timezone and attribution model behind the numbers, and names anything that could not be retrieved rather than filling the gap.

How to set it up
Sign in to Adstudio, connect your ad accounts once, then authorize ChatGPT with OAuth. Access follows your own Adstudio workspaces and your role in them, and every request names one workspace, platform and account explicitly. You choose the access level under Settings > MCP, Read only or Read and write, and you can switch the connection off at any time, which ends access for every connected client.

Adstudio itself is a workspace for advertising teams, with dashboards, custom reports, alerts, notes and tasks around the same accounts at useadstudio.com.
capabilities: Performance questions across connected ad accounts
Breakdowns by date, device, placement, age or gender
Campaign, ad group, ad set and ad structure
Account, currency, date range and attribution on every answer
defaultPrompt: How did my Google Ads campaigns perform last week compared with the week before?
Why did the CPA of my Brand Search campaign go up in the last 14 days?
Rank the ads in my Summer Sale campaign by ROAS and show me what the top three say.

positive.prompt: List my ad accounts in Adstudio.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the "Adstudio ChatGPT Test" workspace with its Google Ads account (2829822056, "Adstudio") and Meta Ads account (1619824365699133, "Adstudio Ads"), each with the access level enabled for that platform. No performance data is fetched yet.

positive.description: Inspect what can be queried for a specific account
positive.prompt: What metrics, levels and breakdowns can I query for the Google Ads account in my Adstudio ChatGPT Test workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: Selects the Google Ads account explicitly and returns its supported levels (account, campaign, ad_group, ad), metrics (impressions, clicks, spend, conversions, conversion_value, impression share), breakdowns, filters and limits. Currency and timezone are not guessed.

positive.prompt: Show me the daily spend and clicks of my Google Ads account from June 26 to July 13, 2026, and tell me which campaign drove that spend.
positive.expected_behavior: Daily rows for 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-13, then campaign rows. Reports about 1,650 TRY spend, roughly 5,000 impressions, 409 clicks and 1 conversion, all from campaign "adstudio_search_data", with provenance (TRY, Europe/Istanbul, attribution note). No invented numbers.

positive.description: Browse the campaign hierarchy and status
positive.prompt: List the campaigns in my Meta Ads account with their status, and show the ad sets under the awareness campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two PAUSED campaigns, "Adstudio_Awareness_Data" (OUTCOME_AWARENESS) and "Adstudio_Engagement_Data" (OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT), then lists the ad set under the awareness campaign using its id as parentId. Structure only, no metrics.

positive.prompt: Show me the ad creatives in my Meta Ads account and summarize what the copy says.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two photo ads with campaign, ad set, status (CAMPAIGN_PAUSED), media and copy. Summarizes the engagement ad's text (run digital marketing across Google, Meta and TikTok by talking to any AI model) and notes that the awareness ad has no text. No performance numbers.

negative.description: Generic advertising advice that needs no account data
negative.prompt: What is a good ROAS target for an e-commerce brand running Meta ads?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers from general knowledge and does not call any Adstudio tool, because no connected-account data is needed.

negative.description: Change requested through tools that only read
negative.prompt: Increase the daily budget of my Brand Search campaign to $200 and pause the underperforming ad groups.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the five tools exposed here (list_accounts, describe_capabilities, query_performance, get_entities, get_creatives) only read, makes no change, and points the user to the Adstudio app for budget and status edits.

negative.prompt: Pull last month's Google Ads performance for a competitor's account that is not connected to my workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that only the workspaces and accounts returned by list_accounts are reachable, does not guess or fabricate an account id, and does not call query_performance.

review.commerce_description: Adstudio does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT. Subscriptions are purchased on useadstudio.com.

publication.release_notes:
Adstudio comes to ChatGPT.

Connect the Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads accounts you manage in Adstudio, then ask for the numbers in plain language: spend, conversions, campaign structure and creatives, with period comparisons and breakdowns by date, device, placement, age or gender.

Every answer names the account, currency, date range, timezone and attribution model behind it, and says when something could not be retrieved.

Three skills are included: an account performance review, a campaign diagnosis and a creative audit.

tr-TR.subtitle: Reklam hesaplarınıza sorun
tr-TR.description:
Adstudio, ChatGPT'nin içinde reklam raporlaması ve analizidir. Adstudio'da bağladığınız Google Ads, Meta Ads ve TikTok Ads hesaplarındaki rakamları sorarsınız: harcama, dönüşüm, kampanya yapısı ve kreatifler. Her reklam panelini tek tek açıp aynı dışa aktarmayı yeniden kurmanıza gerek kalmaz.

Neler sorabilirsiniz
- "Google Ads kampanyalarım geçen hafta bir önceki haftaya göre nasıl performans gösterdi?"
- "Brand Search kampanyamın CPA'sı son 14 günde neden yükseldi?"
- "Bu ay hangi Meta kampanyaları dönüşüm getirmeden bütçe harcadı?"
- "Summer Sale kampanyamdaki reklamları ROAS'a göre sırala ve ilk üçünün metnini göster."

ChatGPT'nin bu eklenti üzerinden okuyabildikleri
Reklam platformları: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook ve Instagram) ve TikTok Ads.
Veri: kampanyalar, reklam grupları, reklam setleri, reklamlar ve kreatifler; harcama, gösterim, tıklama, dönüşüm, dönüşüm değeri, gösterim payı, erişim, sıklık ve video metrikleri; dönem karşılaştırmaları ve tarih, cihaz, yerleşim, yaş veya cinsiyet kırılımları.

Her yanıt hesabı, para birimini, tarih aralığını, saat dilimini ve atıf modelini belirtir; alınamayan bir şey varsa boşluğu doldurmak yerine adını verir.

Kurulum
Adstudio'ya giriş yapın, hesaplarınızı bir kez bağlayın, sonra ChatGPT'yi OAuth ile yetkilendirin. Erişim kendi çalışma alanlarınız ve oradaki rolünüzle sınırlıdır; her istek tek bir çalışma alanını, platformu ve hesabı açıkça adlandırır. Erişim seviyesini Ayarlar > MCP'den seçersiniz: yalnızca okuma ya da okuma ve yazma. Bağlantıyı istediğiniz an kapatabilirsiniz; bu, bağlı tüm istemcilerin erişimini sonlandırır.

de-DE.subtitle: Frag deine Werbekonten
de-DE.description:
Adstudio ist Werbereporting und -analyse in ChatGPT. Frag nach den Zahlen aus den Google-Ads-, Meta-Ads- und TikTok-Ads-Konten, die du in Adstudio verbindest — Ausgaben, Conversions, Kampagnenstruktur und Creatives — statt jeden Werbeanzeigenmanager zu öffnen und denselben Export neu zu bauen.

Was du fragen kannst
- "Wie haben meine Google-Ads-Kampagnen letzte Woche im Vergleich zur Vorwoche abgeschnitten?"
- "Warum ist der CPA meiner Brand-Search-Kampagne in den letzten 14 Tagen gestiegen?"
- "Welche Meta-Kampagnen haben diesen Monat Budget ohne Conversions ausgegeben?"
- "Sortiere die Anzeigen meiner Summer-Sale-Kampagne nach ROAS und zeig mir den Text der Top 3."

Was ChatGPT über dieses Plugin lesen kann
Werbeplattformen: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook und Instagram) und TikTok Ads.
Daten: Kampagnen, Anzeigengruppen, Anzeigensets, Anzeigen und Creatives sowie Ausgaben, Impressionen, Klicks, Conversions, Conversion-Wert, Impression Share, Reichweite, Frequenz und Video-Metriken, mit Zeitraumvergleichen und Aufschlüsselungen nach Datum, Gerät, Platzierung, Alter oder Geschlecht.

Jede Antwort nennt Konto, Währung, Zeitraum, Zeitzone und Attributionsmodell und benennt, was nicht abgerufen werden konnte, statt die Lücke zu füllen.

Einrichtung
Bei Adstudio anmelden, Konten einmalig verbinden, dann ChatGPT per OAuth autorisieren. Der Zugriff folgt deinen eigenen Workspaces und deiner Rolle darin. Die Zugriffsstufe wählst du unter Einstellungen > MCP, und du kannst die Verbindung jederzeit abschalten.

ja-JP.subtitle: 広告アカウントに質問
ja-JP.description:
Adstudio は、ChatGPT の中で行う広告レポートと分析です。Adstudio で接続した Google 広告・Meta 広告・TikTok 広告のアカウントについて、費用、コンバージョン、キャンペーン構成、クリエイティブをたずねるだけ。各広告マネージャーを開いて同じエクスポートを作り直す必要はありません。

こんな質問ができます
- 「先週の Google 広告キャンペーンの成果を、前週と比べて教えて」
- 「Brand Search キャンペーンの CPA が直近 14 日間で上がった理由は？」
- 「今月、コンバージョンがないまま予算を使った Meta キャンペーンは？」
- 「Summer Sale キャンペーンの広告を ROAS 順に並べて、上位 3 件の文面を見せて」

このプラグインで ChatGPT が読み取れるもの
広告プラットフォーム：Google 広告、Meta 広告（Facebook・Instagram）、TikTok 広告。
データ：キャンペーン、広告グループ、広告セット、広告、クリエイティブに加え、費用、インプレッション、クリック、コンバージョン、コンバージョン値、インプレッションシェア、リーチ、フリークエンシー、動画指標。期間比較や、日付・デバイス・配置・年齢・性別ごとの内訳にも対応します。

すべての回答にアカウント、通貨、期間、タイムゾーン、アトリビューションモデルを明示し、取得できなかった項目は補わずにその旨を示します。

設定方法
Adstudio にサインインし、アカウントを一度接続してから、OAuth で ChatGPT を認可します。アクセス範囲はご自身のワークスペースとその権限に限られます。アクセスレベルは設定 > MCP で選択でき、接続はいつでも停止できます。

es-ES.subtitle: Pregunta a tus anuncios
es-ES.description:
Adstudio es informes y análisis de publicidad dentro de ChatGPT. Pide las cifras de las cuentas de Google Ads, Meta Ads y TikTok Ads que conectas en Adstudio —inversión, conversiones, estructura de campañas y creatividades— en lugar de abrir cada gestor de anuncios y rehacer la misma exportación.

Qué puedes preguntar
- "¿Cómo rindieron mis campañas de Google Ads la semana pasada frente a la anterior?"
- "¿Por qué subió el CPA de mi campaña Brand Search en los últimos 14 días?"
- "¿Qué campañas de Meta gastaron presupuesto sin convertir este mes?"
- "Ordena los anuncios de mi campaña Summer Sale por ROAS y muéstrame el texto de los tres primeros."

Qué puede leer ChatGPT con este plugin
Plataformas: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) y TikTok Ads.
Datos: campañas, grupos de anuncios, conjuntos de anuncios, anuncios y creatividades, además de inversión, impresiones, clics, conversiones, valor de conversión, cuota de impresiones, alcance, frecuencia y métricas de vídeo, con comparaciones de periodos y desgloses por fecha, dispositivo, posicionamiento, edad o género.

Cada respuesta indica la cuenta, la moneda, el rango de fechas, la zona horaria y el modelo de atribución detrás de las cifras, y nombra lo que no se pudo obtener en lugar de rellenar el hueco.

Cómo configurarlo
Inicia sesión en Adstudio, conecta tus cuentas una vez y autoriza ChatGPT con OAuth. El acceso sigue tus propios espacios de trabajo y tu rol en ellos, y cada solicitud nombra un espacio, una plataforma y una cuenta de forma explícita. Eliges el nivel de acceso en Ajustes > MCP y puedes desactivar la conexión cuando quieras.

fr-FR.subtitle: Interrogez vos comptes pub
fr-FR.description:
Adstudio, c'est le reporting et l'analyse publicitaires dans ChatGPT. Demandez les chiffres des comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads que vous connectez dans Adstudio — dépenses, conversions, structure des campagnes et créations — au lieu d'ouvrir chaque gestionnaire de publicités et de refaire le même export.

Ce que vous pouvez demander
- « Comment mes campagnes Google Ads ont-elles performé la semaine dernière par rapport à la précédente ? »
- « Pourquoi le CPA de ma campagne Brand Search a-t-il augmenté ces 14 derniers jours ? »
- « Quelles campagnes Meta ont dépensé sans convertir ce mois-ci ? »
- « Classe les annonces de ma campagne Summer Sale par ROAS et montre-moi le texte des trois premières. »

Ce que ChatGPT peut lire via ce plugin
Plateformes : Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook et Instagram) et TikTok Ads.
Données : campagnes, groupes d'annonces, ensembles de publicités, annonces et créations, ainsi que dépenses, impressions, clics, conversions, valeur de conversion, taux d'impressions, couverture, répétition et métriques vidéo, avec comparaisons de périodes et ventilations par date, appareil, placement, âge ou genre.

Chaque réponse précise le compte, la devise, la période, le fuseau horaire et le modèle d'attribution derrière les chiffres, et nomme ce qui n'a pas pu être récupéré plutôt que de combler le vide.

Mise en place
Connectez-vous à Adstudio, reliez vos comptes une fois, puis autorisez ChatGPT via OAuth. L'accès suit vos propres espaces de travail et votre rôle, et chaque requête nomme explicitement un espace, une plateforme et un compte. Vous choisissez le niveau d'accès dans Paramètres > MCP et pouvez couper la connexion à tout moment.

pt-BR.subtitle: Pergunte aos seus anúncios
pt-BR.description:
O Adstudio é relatório e análise de publicidade dentro do ChatGPT. Peça os números das contas de Google Ads, Meta Ads e TikTok Ads que você conecta no Adstudio — investimento, conversões, estrutura de campanhas e criativos — em vez de abrir cada gerenciador de anúncios e refazer a mesma exportação.

O que você pode perguntar
- "Como minhas campanhas do Google Ads performaram na semana passada em relação à anterior?"
- "Por que o CPA da minha campanha Brand Search subiu nos últimos 14 dias?"
- "Quais campanhas do Meta gastaram verba sem converter neste mês?"
- "Ordene os anúncios da minha campanha Summer Sale por ROAS e mostre o texto dos três primeiros."

O que o ChatGPT pode ler com este plugin
Plataformas: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram) e TikTok Ads.
Dados: campanhas, grupos de anúncios, conjuntos de anúncios, anúncios e criativos, além de investimento, impressões, cliques, conversões, valor de conversão, parcela de impressões, alcance, frequência e métricas de vídeo, com comparações de períodos e recortes por data, dispositivo, posicionamento, idade ou gênero.

Cada resposta informa a conta, a moeda, o período, o fuso horário e o modelo de atribuição por trás dos números, e aponta o que não pôde ser obtido em vez de preencher a lacuna.

Como configurar
Entre no Adstudio, conecte suas contas uma vez e autorize o ChatGPT com OAuth. O acesso segue seus próprios workspaces e seu papel neles, e cada requisição nomeia explicitamente um workspace, uma plataforma e uma conta. Você escolhe o nível de acesso em Configurações > MCP e pode desligar a conexão a qualquer momento.
